verification.source: Read live over SSH (scontrol, sinfo, nvidia-smi, gmx --version) and test jobs on 2026-11-25; GPU GRES re-verified after it was added the same day

hardware.cpu: Intel Xeon Gold 6136 (Skylake-SP, AVX-512), 1 socket x 12 cores x 2 threads

scheduler.gpu_request: --gres=gpu:1 (or --gpus=1); gpu:2 or more is refused at submit
scheduler.select: cons_tres, CR_CORE_MEMORY (CPUs and memory are allocated per job)
scheduler.history: No sacct. Finished jobs are only visible via scontrol for a short time after completion.
scheduler.gpu_isolation: none — no cgroup ConstrainDevices, so jobs without a GPU request can still see the GPU

storage.home: /home/<group>/<user> (local disk, shared with the OS root filesystem, ~1.8 TB total)
storage.node_local_scratch: the whole filesystem is local; there is no separate shared filesystem

modules.nvhpc: module use /opt/nvidia/hpc_sdk/modulefiles; then nvhpc/24.5, nvhpc-nompi/24.5, nvhpc-hpcx/24.5, nvhpc-hpcx-cuda12/24.5, nvhpc-openmpi3/24.5, nvhpc-byo-compiler/24.5

software.cuda: 12.4, bundled in the HPC SDK (/opt/nvidia/hpc_sdk/Linux_x86_64/24.5/cuda); no /usr/local/cuda
software.mpi: system Open MPI 4.1.6 (/usr/bin/mpirun); srun supports pmi2 and pmix
